title: A Beautiful Day Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Renovated in Winter 2026, chef's kitchen, newly added dining room, 3rd bedroom w/ensuite bath! Prime Seaside location! Only 194 feet or a 1 Min. walk from beach access on East Ruskin Street and only 1/2 a block to the action at Seaside Central Square!
description_expanded: Description37 EAST RUSKIN STREET2 KINGS, 2 QUEENS- sleeps 8* Home undergoing extensive renovations in Winter and Spring 2026. Raising the roof, brand new renovated kitchen, adding onto the rear of the home with a new dining area, and a true third bedroom with ensuite bathroom is being added! Will be a 3BD/3BA/Sleeps 8. To be complete early JUNE 2026 - New images to come, stay tuned!A Luxury Reimagining in the Heart of SeasideA Beautiful Day is currently undergoing a full-scale, high-end renovation and will debut in June 2026 as a beautifully reimagined three-bedroom, three-bath luxury beach home accommodating up to eight guests. Ideally located in the heart of Seaside, Florida, the home sits just 194 feet from the private East Ruskin Pavilion beach access and is only a short walk to Seaside’s iconic Central Square, where more than 35 shops and restaurants await.Blending Seaside’s timeless coastal charm with fresh, modern luxury, this thoughtfully redesigned home promises an elevated beach retreat in one of 30A’s most desirable locations.Thoughtful Renovation & Expanded Living SpacesThe owners are sparing no expense in transforming this beloved Seaside cottage into a refined yet welcoming coastal escape. A raised roofline enhances the home’s sense of openness, while a new rear addition introduces a sun-filled dining room wrapped in windows overlooking the landscaped yard—creating a seamless indoor-outdoor connection.At the heart of the home, a brand-new chef’s kitchen will anchor gatherings with both beauty and functionality, featuring:Custom cabinetryQuartz countertopsCounter-height bar seatingPremium KitchenAid stainless steel appliancesEvery detail has been carefully curated to support effortless entertaining and relaxed coastal living.Inviting Living & Entertaining AreasThe home’s iconic screened front porch remains a standout feature, offering a welcoming space with a sofa, club chairs, coffee table, and a charming twin hanging bed—perfect for morning coffee, afternoon lounging, or evening cocktails after the beach.Inside, guests will enjoy all-new luxury furnishings, designer décor, and a large wall-mounted flat-screen TV, making the living space ideal for family movie nights or unwinding after a sun-soaked day along the Gulf.Well-Appointed Bedrooms & Spa-Inspired BathsEach bedroom is designed to provide privacy, comfort, and elevated finishes:Primary King Suite (Front of Home) A serene retreat featuring built-in storage, a flat-screen TV, and a private ensuite bath with a single vanity and a glass-enclosed spa-style walk-in shower complete with rain head and handheld option.Second King Suite Perfect for families, this suite includes a flat-screen TV, closet, and an ensuite bath with a glass-paneled tub/shower combination, offering spa-like features ideal for both adults and bathing little ones.Third Bedroom (New Addition)Designed for flexibility and comfort, this new suite features two queen beds, built-in storage, a pocket door for added privacy, and an ensuite bath with modern finishes, a single vanity, and a glass-enclosed shower.*5 night minimum stay Spring & Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES1,394 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceOne-minute walk (194 feet) to private beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion, home to the largest stretch of private residential beaches on 30ASonos surround sound system with speakers throughout the living, dining, and kitchen areasEnclosed outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beachShared charcoal grill conveniently located along the footpathStackable washer and dryer housed in a dedicated laundry closetPeacock Alley Premier Linen Partner – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels, sheets, and coverlets throughout the homeAccess to three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking & Policies: Two parking passes issued; a golf cart is considered a vehicle. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; medical or special circumstances require a permitted exception. No pets allowedSTR23-002132
